text:
Maya (CS): Kicking off the touchpoint rhythm for the CinderX preview cohort we're enrolling this month. TL;DR: 3 onboarding sessions + weekly 2-week pulse + product feedback survey on day 14 and 45. Notion packet: https://redwood.in/notes/cinderx-onboard :sparkles:

Jules - PM: love it. can we make session 2 optional for power users? also need an ask list for eng to prep a small config toggle.

Priya (Eng): yes — feature flag `preview.cinderx.enableNewCache` will be ready by Mon. what's session 2 agenda?

Maya (CS): Session 1 = quick setup + SSO, Session 2 = advanced prompts & batching config (opt-in), Session 3 = report out + renewal checklist. I'll attach the packet and a short slide deck.

Leo (SRE): want telemetry hooks for prefix cache metrics. add this snippet to integration guide: ```curl -X POST https://telemetry.redwood.internal/events -d '{"metric":"cache_hit_rate","value":0.0}'```

Priya (Eng): noted, will add hook and flag the PII handling. can we get sample prompts from the customer to validate prompt.invoke schema?

Samir (Customer): happy to share — we'll export 10 canonical prompts. also can you make the day-45 survey shorter? our product team is slammed.

Maya (CS): good call — trim to 7 Qs and focus on key adoption signals (ease, value, blockers, NPS). Samir pls send prompts to this thread or DM. :thumbsup: 

Jules - PM: for renewal signal — let's add an `engagement_score` computed from (weeks_active, avg_session_minutes, survey_nps). can CS ops run a backfill for the existing cohort so we have a baseline?

Maya (CS): yes, we can backfill. ops team: @Priya (Eng) @Leo (SRE) please confirm the events needed and I'll queue the job.

Priya (Eng): events: `session.start`, `session.complete`, `feature.toggle`, `prompt.invoke` (with hashed prompt_id). will push schema + staging hook by EOD.

eng-deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-hook branch -> staging, build 5a3c4f triggered by @Priya at 16:02 UTC :rocket:

Leo (SRE): once staging is green, I can add a Grafana dashboard and an alert if engagement drops below threshold (propose threshold = 0.6).

Maya (CS): Scheduling: onboarding session slots for the cohort: Tue 10am, Thu 3pm, Mon 9am — prefer Tue 10 primary. Samir — pick one pls.

Samir (Customer): Thu 3pm works for our team.

Jules - PM: can CS also run a brief 'renewal risk playbook' doc when engagement_score < 0.6? I'll draft the playbook (outreach templates + enablement offer).

Maya (CS): yes — include outreach templates, offer a 1:1 enablement workshop, and an exec-summary one-pager. I'll add to Notion and share the link here.

Priya (Eng): quick Q — for `prompt.invoke` hashing, confirm we only store hashed prompt_id and not raw prompt content in telemetry.

Maya (CS): correct — only hashed id stored, aligns with privacy policy and legal.

Samir (Customer): thanks all — will send prompts and confirm attendee list by EOD. excited to get started. :handshake:
